name: I Love Cameroon Monument
description: A bold symbol of national pride in the heart of Yaoundé, and a memorable starting point for any Cameroon visit.

details.overview: A city landmark that celebrates Cameroon’s identity and is one of the best-known monuments in the capital.
details.story: The monument was conceived as a welcoming landmark for visitors and a symbol of national pride for residents, especially around civic events and celebrations.
highlights: Close to downtown cafes and city routes

name: Reunification Monument
description: A spiralling landmark commemorating Cameroon’s reunification, offering panoramic views over the city.

details.overview: A dramatic monument that tells the story of national unity and offers a sweeping look over the capital.
details.story: The monument honours Cameroon’s reunification and is deeply tied to the country’s post-independence history and civic identity.

name: Notre-Dame des Victoires Cathedral
description: A striking cathedral and one of Yaoundé’s most photographed landmarks, admired for its modern silhouette.

details.overview: A calm religious landmark with striking architecture and strong cultural presence in central Yaoundé.
details.story: The cathedral has become one of the city’s most recognisable sacred spaces and a place of both worship and urban heritage.

name: Basilica Marie-Reine des Apôtres
local_name: Basilique Marie-Reine des Apôtres de Mvolyé
description: Perched above the capital, this basilica is known for dramatic views and serene architecture.

details.overview: A hilltop basilica with a majestic presence and a story of religious devotion tied to the city’s higher districts.
details.story: Its elevated location makes it both a place of worship and a vantage point for seeing how Yaoundé stretches across the hills.
highlights: A popular stop for scenic drives

name: Mvog-Betsi Zoo & Botanical Garden
description: A green urban retreat where wildlife, shaded paths, and botanical gardens make for a relaxing day out.

details.overview: A leafy family-friendly escape where nature and wildlife meet easy city access.
details.story: The garden and zoo offer a calm space for learning, slow walks and outdoor time in the middle of the capital.

name: Marché Central
description: A bustling market full of fabrics, spices, crafts and local street food—an authentic taste of Yaoundé life.

details.overview: A lively cultural market where local commerce, colour and flavours bring the capital to life.
details.story: The market is one of the easiest places to feel the daily rhythms of Yaoundé, from street food to handmade crafts.

name: Mont Fébé Summit
description: A scenic escape with fresh air, green ridges, and one of the best elevated viewpoints over the capital.

details.overview: An elevated landscape that feels like a breath of fresh air above the city’s busiest streets.
details.story: The summit is a favourite for visitors who want a short outdoor escape and a wide perspective over the capital.

name: Palais des Congrès
description: A central cultural venue where exhibitions, concerts and national events bring Yaoundé to life.

details.overview: A modern event hub where arts, business and public celebrations meet in the city centre.
details.story: It is one of the venues that keeps Yaoundé active after dark, especially during conferences and national occasions.

name: National Museum of Cameroon
description: A cultural landmark for learning about Cameroon’s heritage, traditional art, and historic collections.

details.overview: A cultural stop for anyone interested in Cameroon’s deep historical and artistic heritage.
details.story: The museum showcases the country’s traditions and makes a great stop for travellers who want more context beyond the city’s landmarks.

name: Place du 20 Mai
description: A busy city square that showcases local life, street vendors, and Yaoundé’s downtown energy.

details.overview: A vibrant plaza where city life, conversation and movement feel closest to the everyday rhythm of Yaoundé.
details.story: The square is a favourite meeting point for local residents and visitors who want to experience downtown energy without leaving the centre.
highlights: Street food and casual cafés nearby

name: Lac Municipal
description: A peaceful urban lake where residents and visitors stroll, relax, and enjoy a quiet moment in the city.

details.overview: A peaceful water-side retreat that helps soften the pace of the city.
details.story: The lake is known for evening walks and easy relaxation, making it one of the city’s best low-key escapes.

name: Stade Omnisports de Yaoundé
description: Yaoundé’s biggest stadium and a landmark for football, concerts, and national events.

details.overview: A major sporting and entertainment venue with a strong role in the city’s public life.
details.story: The stadium hosts football matches, concerts and civic gatherings, making it a strong marker of city energy.

name: Marché Mokolo
description: A vibrant market district known for its energy, street food and everyday commerce.

details.overview: A lively market area where you can experience everyday Yaoundé life, from food to fashion and conversation.
details.story: Mokolo is one of the city’s most active neighbourhoods for trade and daily movement, making it a great stop for culture and people-watching.

name: Parc de la Mairie
description: A calm green space for outdoor breaks, casual walks and relaxed family time.

details.overview: A simple and welcoming park for a quiet break between city stops.
details.story: It works well for short picnics, gentle walks and slow afternoons when you want to reset without leaving town.

name: Le Ciel Restaurant
description: A polished restaurant choice for a comfortable meal, relaxed atmosphere and good city views.

details.overview: A city-centre dining spot that is especially attractive for evening meals and relaxed social visits.
details.story: The restaurant is known as a comfortable place to take a break after sightseeing or to enjoy a slow dinner downtown.

name: Hôtel Mont Fébé
description: A classic hotel stay with a calm setting and easy access to the city’s higher viewpoints.

details.overview: A comfortable accommodation option that blends city access with the calm of the hilltop districts.
details.story: Its location is one of the reasons travellers choose it when they want both convenience and a quieter setting.

name: Hôtel La Falaise
description: A welcoming stay for travellers looking for comfort, greenery and a quieter escape.

details.overview: A stylish accommodation option that feels more private and restful than the busy downtown core.
details.story: The property is appreciated for its calmer atmosphere and the sense of space it offers to guests.

name: Jardin Botanique de Yaoundé
description: A peaceful botanical garden that makes for a calm outdoor break with plenty of greenery.

details.overview: A nature-forward stop that gives visitors a slower pace and a more verdant side of the city.
details.story: Botanical gardens offer a great way to see the region’s plant life while enjoying a picnic or an easy walk.

name: Mokolo Market
description: A lively local market where food, crafts and everyday city life come together in one busy space.

details.overview: A practical and colourful market stop that captures the day-to-day energy of the city.
details.story: Mokolo remains one of the easiest places to experience local commerce, street food and neighbourhood life.

name: Palais de la Culture
description: A cultural hall for exhibitions, performances and public events that bring local creativity to life.

details.overview: A venue for concerts, exhibitions and special city events connected to Cameroon’s creative scene.
details.story: It’s a useful stop for visitors who want a cultural evening or to catch something happening during their stay.
